source.title: [Feature · V1] Centre, B2B, and case types — Education Partner join, thin public channel, Enquire-only courses, and tutor-pays centre fee flow
source.body:
**Packed ticket for posting to `keyframesfound/matchmaxhk` (full pack, 2026-11-21).** This is one working issue, not a restore of the old pile. Cite prior work as `[was #256]`, `[was #257]`, `[was #258]`, `[was #265]`, `[was #266]`, `[was #272]`, `[was #273]`, `[was #274]`, `[was #391]`, `[was #412]`, `[was #442]`, `[was #465]`, `[was #550]`, `[was #577]`, `[was #578]`, `[was #582]`, `[was #583]`, and Join Option 4 `[was #576]`. If GitHub Support later restores those originals, fold or close them into this ticket and keep editing here. Live repo check 2026-11-21 (Asia/Hong_Kong): none of those constituent issue numbers exist on `keyframesfound/matchmaxhk` (they were not restored). **This is a new parent**, not a body-edit of an existing open issue.

**Packs in full — the official CENTRE stack (Centre, B2B, and case types).** This is the Education Partner join restyle, the Thin Partner Channel (public `/business/[slug]`, Enquire-only course cards, Our Tutors, materials via existing notes rails), centre student cases and partnership terms, 3-stage centre-case reveal, Private / Centre / Activity-Gig case types, tutor-pays B2B fee flow (including the same-centre ladder), EA-safe triage, and the overflow / referral lane. It folds the CEO-approved 2026-11-19 `/business/join` slice (never posted as its own issue).

**Bilingual field map for the join sheet (SoT, do not invent parallel copy):** the approved 2026-11-19 bilingual field map is appended at the end of this ticket. Labels, helpers, checkboxes, and chip lists come from that appendix. Do not invent parallel copy.

**Already shipped (cite only, do not rebuild):** Checked 2026-11-21 (Asia/Hong_Kong) against https://matchmax.hk and the `main` tree on the box.

- Public `/business/join` (EN + zh) already exists. Guest fills first; Google OAuth only on Submit; no password; no login wall. Required KYB today: public name, `legal_entity_name`, `br_number`, `org_type` (tutorial centre / day school / NGO as a **dropdown**), `rep_name` + `rep_role`, contact email and phone, optional trading name, conditional EDB / charity identifier, authority + ToS + fee acknowledgements. Location today is a single HK District select, including “No district” as a skip. There is **no** country, city, or timezone field on the live sheet. Staff review Business Registration before the account goes live. No payment is taken on the website. `createOrganization` rejects a submit without `br_number` and the authority acknowledgement. Cite closed **#759** / PR **#781**. This ticket restyles and extends that sheet — it does not invent a second join product.
- A public organisation channel already exists at `/business/[slug]` (About, Courses with “Enquire for pricing”, optional class schedule, and a “Get in touch” block that can show website and contact email). A Centre Workspace already exists at `/business` with overview / courses / cases / team / profile tabs. **Team** already supports Invite admin, owner vs admin, pending / active / revoke (`workspace_members`). `/business/team` redirects to `/business?tab=team`. Do **not** rebuild the Team table or invite modal.
- `/en/guide/partners` is live (HTTP 200). Some of its fee sentences are **stale** against later locks — fix the copy in this ticket; do not invent a new fee.
- Notes / materials checkout, 2% + 72h, and Partner Centre as a seller stay in posted **#784** (`[was #543]` / `[was #573]`). Phone-after-fee and ToS/Privacy stay in posted **#783** (`[was #255]`). Fee math, 1.5-lesson / short-case 20% / pro-bono $0, and the same-centre ladder SoT stay in closed **#760** (`[was #508]` / `[was #615]` / `[was #756]`). Case Workspace / Case Manager stay in posted **#785**. Tutor join helpers and city/timezone on the **tutor** form stay in posted **#798**. WhatsApp / Ops desk stay in posted **#797**. Auth remains closed **#759**.
- Closed `[was #578]` is the same Thin Centre Channel title as `[was #577]`. Implement **once** here. Closed `[was #550]` is the B2B Centre Workspace — treat as **shipped enough to reuse** (invite + team table already live). This ticket only fills leftover handoff (routing, switcher, audit) if they are still missing. Do not reopen #550.

**Do not implement:** Vacancy / job / apply-to-centre storefront (`[was #413]`, parked). Institutional class tuition cart, seat inventory, multi-seat checkout, or season prepay (`[was #458]`, `[was #266]` season payments, `[was #272]` paid Enrol). Tutoring tuition escrow / Stripe Connect payouts (`[was #475]`). Full Classcard-style Academy Ops (`[was #530]`, later ACADEMY ticket). Password accounts, magic link, OTP, or forgot-password (closed **#759** / `#732` lock). Fashion-level UI polish held until Wave 1 is done. Official post-signup coach-mark tours (`#397`, later ONBOARD). STAFF cockpit / `#657` wave board (separate later ticket). Parked Community posts as a social network (`#549` social posts stay in **#794** as later profile work — this ticket may have a Posts tab empty state, it does not rebuild a social feed). Do not invent a second organisation system or a loud parallel `/b2b` brand.

**Related, not built in this ticket:** #759 end-of-flow Google. #760 / #785 fee settlement and Case Workspace. #783 phones after fee + legal copy. #784 notes checkout. #794 ratings / proofs. #797 WhatsApp desk (centre fee memory may be *stated* there; the product lives here). #798 tutor city/timezone (same field rules are *reused* on the centre join sheet).

---

## How to read this ticket (conflict SoT)

Later CEO locks win where recovered bodies disagree.

1. **Join form locks of 2026-11-19 (Asia/Hong_Kong) supersede older “60-second thin sheet” field lists in `[was #577]` / `[was #578]`.** KYB stays on the public sheet. Google only at Submit. Email is required; phone is required with a pre-checked WhatsApp toggle (no email-only submit). Organisation type is **three pills**, not a dropdown. English public name is required; 繁中 public name is optional; `@slug` is generated silently (editable later in settings, not on this form). Tagline, about, website, and optional logo move to a post-submit “Complete your channel” card — storefront only, not a second KYB gate. Country / Region, City / locality, and a confirmable IANA timezone follow the same locks as **#798**. No street address, map pin, or mandatory GPS to submit, and no street address on the public channel. Combine ToS, Privacy, and the Fee Agreement into one checkbox, but the **full fee paragraph stays visible**.
2. **Centres pay HK$0 matching fee. The “B2B Partner Introduction Fee” is the same tutor-paid 1.5-lesson admin fee already in Terms section 15** (including the same-centre ladder, 20% short-case, and pro-bono $0). It is **not** a second, centre-paid course-referral fee. Do not add a new clause to fee-2026-10-v3. Recovered `[was #577]` checkbox text that “the centre agrees a B2B introduction fee on enrolled referrals,” live `/guide/partners` sentences that “you pay an introduction fee only when a referred student successfully enrols” / “Centres pay a stepped introduction fee,” and early `[was #256]` “payer_party defaults to parent / the tutor is never the payer” are **STALE**. The 2026-10-21 `#412` fee-payer lock and `[was #582]` / **#760** win: parents and centres are not invoiced a matching fee; the self-employed tutor pays the admin fee; tuition is paid directly to the tutor; MatchMax does not hold tuition.
3. **Course cards are Enquire / lead-gen only.** No on-platform class tuition cart. Digital notes still use **#784** rails.
4. **Cap. 57 / Cap. 279 stay on.** MatchMax is not an employment agency and is not the Cap. 279 registrar. No vacancy board. Affiliated tutors are independent educators. Overflow never stores the end-parent.
5. **Fee formulas are not redesigned here.** Display and enforce the already-locked SoT from **#760** / Terms §15. The same-centre 6-month retained-only ladder (`1.5` → `1.0` → `0.5` → `$0` for 4th+; `$0` after Day 180; do not re-dispatch that tutor to the same centre for free after the window) is implemented as behaviour in this ticket, citing **#760** `[was #508]`.
6. **`[was #391]` money-order language is stale where it says the parent pays MatchMax by FPS for group classes and the tutor receives $0 for Lesson 1.** Keep the useful product: Cap. 279 individual-tutor 6-seat cap, card floor price from 1-on-1 rows only, group badge, sibling / `student_count` fee scaling, PDPO stranger privacy, and the sequenced EDB higher-cap path. Do **not** implement a self-serve “unrelated parents enrol in an open cohort cart” in this ticket (that is a class tuition cart; parked with `#458`). Leave the exact group-class billing clock as an **open question** rather than inventing a third fee model.
7. **`[was #442]` “org type includes Agency / Broker” conflicts with the 2026-11-19 three-pill lock** (tutorial centre / day school / NGO) and with the live `org_type` enum. Do **not** add a fourth pill in this ticket until the CEO confirms. Overflow / referral behaviour can still ship for approved Partner Organisations.

## Part 2 — Still missing (the only new build list)

### 2.1 Education Partner join form restyle `[was #412]` `[was #577]` `[was #576]`

**Find on GitHub / live:** `src/routes/_authenticated.business.join.tsx`, https://matchmax.hk/en/business/join and `/zh/business/join`.

This is a restyle and field update of the live sheet, plus a small post-submit card. It is not a new product, not a wizard, and not a centre shop. Use `EDUCATION-PARTNER-FORM-INTEGRATION.md` for copy.

**MUST**

- `/business/join` remains **one scrolling sheet** (no stepper). Submit stays disabled until required fields and the mandatory confirmations are complete, with an inline reason.
- Guest draft is saved **before** Google and restored on return, including after an in-app-browser OAuth failure, via a resume-link card: **Copy resume link & open in Safari / Chrome** / **複製續填連結，並用 Safari／Chrome 開啟**, plus a hint to open in the system browser.
- `createOrganization` still rejects without `br_number` and `authorityAck`. Typical HK BR helper is 8 digits (e.g. 12345678); non-8-digit organisation identifiers are not hard-blocked.
- Chips on the same page: primary goal, curricula, subject areas, and required district(s) or Online. Foundation / other is available. On a phone, show 8–10 subject chips with **Show all subjects** / **顯示全部科目**. Course-listing as a primary-goal chip is Enquire / lead-gen only.
- **Country / Region** is required, same options as the tutor form (Hong Kong, Mainland China, Macau, Singapore, United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Australia, Other), default Hong Kong. No second country field.
- **City / locality** is required — not a street address, and not mandatory GPS. When the country is Hong Kong, city may default to “Hong Kong”, and the already-locked required district(s) or Online chips stay (“No district” is still **not** a skip). When the country is not Hong Kong, do not force Hong Kong district chips; city and a confirmed timezone are the location fields, and Online may still be selected.
- Derive an IANA timezone from country + city, show it, and require confirm or correct. A browser timezone may hint only and **must not** silently overwrite a confirmed value. Staff and matching may use country, city, and timezone as allocation **signals**. Do not hard-block matches across timezones in this change.
- English public name required; 繁中 public name optional; `@slug` generated silently.
- Merge phone and WhatsApp into one required number with a pre-checked WhatsApp toggle. Email stays required.
- Organisation type is **three pills**, not a dropdown: Tutorial centre / 補習社 · Day school / 日校 · NGO / 非政府機構.
- Move tagline, about, website, and optional logo off the join sheet onto a post-submit **Complete your channel** / **完善你嘅頻道** card. That card must not delay staff receipt of the application. Account stays pending staff review after submit.
- Combine ToS, Privacy, and the Fee Agreement into one checkbox; the full fee paragraph stays visible. A short “HK$0 matching fee for centres” / 「中心配對費為港幣 $0」 callout is allowed; it must not replace that paragraph. Add the missing Cap. 57 / Cap. 279 acknowledgement. The Cap. 57 box must not imply a centre-paid charge.
- Optional BR photo/PDF is help for review, not a substitute for typing the number. Ship the uploader only if a guest can store the file before Google sign-in; otherwise omit the control.
- zh route: Traditional Chinese labels. Helpers and buttons: colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese. Authority, fee, and Cap. 57 / Cap. 279 clauses: formal-but-clear Hong Kong legal 繁中. No leftover English labels on the zh route.

**MUST NOT**

- Do not defer `legal_entity_name`, `br_number`, or the authority checkbox, and do not add “Skip BR for now.”
- Do not force Google before the form, and do not add a second sign-in method, magic link, OTP, password, or forgot-password.
- Do not unpark `#413`, on-platform class checkout, faculty roster **management**, or Our Tutors management **on this join form**.
- Do not invent a new fee. Do not publish EDB, charity, or logo trust pills before staff verification.
- Do not write success or follow-up copy that advertises unverified tutor inventory.
- Do not require a street address, map pin, or live GPS to submit, and do not put a street address on the public channel.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] AC-JOIN-1: `/business/join` remains one scrolling sheet. Submit stays disabled until required fields and the mandatory confirmations are complete, with an inline reason.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-2: Guest draft is saved before Google and restored on return, including after an in-app-browser OAuth failure, via the resume-link card.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-3: `createOrganization` still rejects without `br_number` and `authorityAck`. Non-8-digit organisation identifiers are not hard-blocked.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-4: Chips for primary goal, curricula, and subjects are required; Foundation / other is available. When country is Hong Kong, district or Online is required and “No district” is not a skip. When country is not Hong Kong, Hong Kong district chips are not forced; Online may still be selected.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-5: Fee copy on the form matches Terms section 15: tutor-paid 1.5, same-centre ladder, 20% short-case, pro-bono $0, centres pay HK$0 matching fee. The Cap. 57 box does not imply a centre-paid charge.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-6: zh labels, helpers, chips, and the legal checkbox(es) are complete in 繁中 as in the integration file. No leftover English labels on the zh route.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-7: After submit, the account is pending staff review. The optional channel-profile card can collect tagline, about, website, and logo, and must not delay staff receipt of the application.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-8: Country / Region is required, same options as the tutor form (8 + Other), default Hong Kong. No second country field is added.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-9: City / locality is required. When country is Hong Kong, city may default to “Hong Kong”, and the district or Online rule in AC-JOIN-4 still applies.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-10: When country is not Hong Kong, city / locality and a confirmed timezone are the location fields; Hong Kong district chips are not forced; Online may still be selected.
- [ ] AC-JOIN-11: A confirmed IANA timezone is stored, with the same derive-and-confirm rule as #798. Browser timezone never silently overwrites a confirmed value. Submit does not require a street address, map pin, or GPS permission, and a street address is not shown on the public channel.

### 2.2 Public Thin Partner Channel `[was #577]` `[was #265]`

**Find on GitHub / live:** `src/routes/business.$slug.tsx`, `/en/business/[slug]`.

**Outreach definition of done (CEO 2026-11-03, still in force):** a founder can honestly offer: **Free Partner Centre** → public channel · Notes/materials via existing rails · affiliated tutors · centre student cases / tutor obtain · Cap. 57 independent-educator posture. Course cards = **Enquire** (lead-gen). **No** on-platform class tuition cart. Empty states must not imply a full tuition shop.

**MUST** — surface `/en/business/[slug]` and the 繁中 locale twin:

- Header: logo, public name, `@slug`, districts / city (see open question on whether city is public), optional **Verified Partner** / **認證合作夥伴** badge only when the partnership is staff-approved, optional verified EDB pill only after staff verification.
- Sticky / primary CTA: **Enquire with Centre** / **向中心查詢**.
- Stats row (counts): Affiliated Tutors · Active Courses · Study Notes.
- Tabs: **Courses & Classes** / **課程及常規班** · **Our Tutors** / **導師團隊** · **Study Materials** / **精讀筆記** · **Posts** / **中心動態**.
- Footnote (always visible on the public view): **Partner Centre listings are operated independently by the respective institution. Affiliated tutors operate as independent educators.** / **合作教育中心之課程由該機構獨立營辦；所列導師均以獨立教育工作者身份合作。**
- Unpublished or unapproved centres 404 for the public. No phone number of an affiliated tutor is visible on the channel or on a tutor card in the Our Tutors tab. No wage / salary / “hire staff” language.
- No Hire / Recruit / Vacancy / Apply-to-centre language anywhere on the channel.
- Empty + loading skeleton + inline error on every tab. Owner Edit Mode shows add CTAs; a public visitor sees a soft empty (no broken admin buttons).

**MUST NOT** — do not turn the channel into a shop or a careers page. Do not put a street address on the public channel. Do not publish unverified EDB / charity / logo trust pills. Align the live “Get in touch” email/website block with Enquire-first behaviour (see Open questions) rather than silently adding a new public desk phone.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] AC-CH-1: Desktop 3-col / mobile 1-col layouts; sticky Enquire CTA is reachable on mobile.
- [ ] AC-CH-2: Verified Partner badge only when org partnership is approved; EDB pill only when staff-verified.

- [ ] AC-CH-4: Tabs, CTA, Cap. 57 subtitle, footnote, and empty states use the locked EN + 繁中 copy below (and in §2.3–2.5).
- [ ] AC-CH-5: A visitor cannot see an affiliated tutor’s phone. A centre desk number, if ever shown, is not copied onto a tutor card.

### 2.3 Our Tutors tab and lead routing `[was #577]` `[was #273]`

**MUST**

- Permanent Cap. 57 subtitle when the tab has content: **Verified independent educators and faculty affiliated with {Centre Name}.** / **與 {Centre Name} 合作之認證獨立導師及教學團隊。**
- A tutor appears **only** when both the tutor and a Centre Admin have approved the affiliation. Declined or revoked affiliates never list. Revoking an affiliate drops them from the tab and clears `assigned_tutor_id` on course cards that pointed at them.
- A tutor with a live card can request to join; the centre accepts or declines. Accepted tutors show as public cards. No phone. No wage.
- **Routing (locked):** Request Lesson from the Our Tutors tab (or a centre course card with an assigned affiliate) → Centre Workspace inbox (`case.centre_id` set, tagged `[Requested Tutor: …]` / **指定導師**). The same tutor’s standalone public profile → individual tutor case (`case.centre_id` null).
- Empty: **No affiliated tutors yet** / **尚未有合作導師**, plus an owner CTA to invite / affiliate.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] AC-TUT-1: Unapproved / revoked affiliates never list.
- [ ] AC-TUT-2: Cap. 57 subtitle is always visible when the tab has content.
- [ ] AC-TUT-3: A request from the Our Tutors tab lands in the Centre Workspace inbox with the tutor tag; a standalone `/tutors` request does not route to the centre.
- [ ] AC-TUT-4: Empty state uses the locked EN + 繁中 copy; owner sees an add / invite CTA, public visitors do not.

### 2.4 Study Materials tab `[was #577]` `[was #274]`

**MUST** — list centre-published materials on the public Materials tab. Checkout is the existing **#784** goods rails (2% + 72h). Owner / staff in Workspace Mode can add / publish **as Centre**. Partner Centre seller badge when applicable. Empty: **No study materials yet** / **尚未有精讀筆記**, plus an owner CTA.

**MUST NOT** — do not invent a second checkout. Do not use this tab for class tuition. Do not unpark `#413` vacancy ads. Recovered `[was #274]` “course and event Enrol with paid seats” stays **parked** with the class cart. Official past papers / HKEAA / IB papers remain prohibited (already in **#783** / **#784**).

**Acceptance**

- [ ] AC-MAT-1: Published centre materials are visible on the public Materials tab and buy with the #784 SoT (no tuition cart).
- [ ] AC-MAT-2: Empty state uses the locked EN + 繁中 copy.

### 2.5 Course Showcase — Enquire only `[was #577]`

**MUST** — Centre admin can add / edit / unpublish cards. Fields: title EN / 繁中; curriculum + subject + target grade; format (Small Group (Max N) / Intensive Bootcamp / 1-on-1 Centre Tuition / Admissions Consultation); location/mode; `schedule_summary` ≤100 characters; `price_display`; optional Trial badge; optional `assigned_tutor_id` (approved affiliate only); ≤3 highlights ≤300 characters; optional `instruction_languages[]`: English | Cantonese | Mandarin.

CTA: **Enquire / Reserve Seat →** / **查詢／預留學位 →**. Enquiry modal is pre-filled with `course_id` + `centre_id` and “Who is this for?” (Myself / My Child). It creates a Centre Case Lead in the Centre Workspace Inbox (notify Centre Admin + Concierge). **No Stripe.**

Empty: **No courses listed yet** / **尚未列出課程**, plus owner **+ Add Course / Class** / **新增課程／班別**.

**MUST NOT** — collect course tuition on-platform; build a seat inventory engine or multi-seat cart; imply a reserved seat is a paid enrolment.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] AC-CRS-1: Centre admin can add / edit / unpublish Enquire-only cards with the fields above.
- [ ] AC-CRS-2: Enquire submits a structured lead to the Centre Inbox with the course title attached, and there is no payment step.
- [ ] AC-CRS-3: Empty state and CTA use the locked EN + 繁中 copy. Desktop 3-col / mobile 1-col; sticky enquire is reachable on mobile.

### 2.7 Guide / Partners copy, EA-safe triage, and partnership terms `[was #258]` `[was #412]` `[was #257]`

**MUST**

- Fix stale `/guide/partners` (and any How-it-Works / Help twins) so Phase 1 copy matches the lock: what you get (verified independent tutors for overflow / named students); what you keep (your client relationship); **what you pay MatchMax: HK$0 matching fee** (the tutor pays the standard 1.5-lesson admin, including the same-centre ladder); what you don’t get (staff hiring, vacancy, reception cover). Optional `/b2b` may redirect to `/guide/partners`. There is no “hire tutors” / careers CTA.
- A partner centre can ask MatchMax to introduce a tutor for **one named student**. Copy: we introduce a tutor; we do not hire staff for the centre; we do not post jobs; a public advert / vacancy is not available.
- EA-safe pre-matching triage and `COMPLIANCE_HOLD` remain in force (`[was #412]`). Requests that would place a tutor under administrative, reception, or other non-teaching staff duties, or otherwise resemble employment, are held or declined. Cap. 57 independent-service screen on every B2B overflow.
- Partnership: no request is introduced until the centre’s partnership / authority is accepted (live staff review already gates go-live). Either side can end the partnership; open admin fees stay due. The centre will not republish a phone from a MatchMax intro. Hong Kong law. This is not an employment-agency contract. Unsigned / unapproved centres can save a draft and cannot be introduced.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] AC-GD-1: `/guide/partners` no longer tells centres they pay a stepped introduction / enrolment fee to MatchMax. It states HK$0 matching fee for the organisation and tutor-pays 1.5 / ladder, in EN + 繁中.
- [ ] AC-GD-2: The guide / Partners surface has no “hire tutors” button and does not offer a vacancy board.
- [ ] AC-GD-3: An unapproved centre can save a draft and cannot be introduced to a tutor. Employment-like requests can be placed on `COMPLIANCE_HOLD`.

### 2.8 Centre student case `[was #256]`

**MUST** — a partner centre sends **one named student**. Fields: student first name, school optional, curriculum, subject, level, hours per week, district or online, language, rate ceiling, start date, note. One student per request. A note that asks for a pool of tutors is rejected. `organisation_id` is the centre; `assigned_tutor_id` is the tutor. A default centre case does not create a **centre** invoice (the tutor pays the admin fee per **#760**). The public site has no vacancy and no apply-to-centre button on this flow.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] AC-C1-1: A five-tutor / tutor-pool request cannot be submitted.
- [ ] AC-C1-2: A default centre case does not invoice the centre a matching fee.
- [ ] AC-C1-3: The public site has no vacancy and no apply-to-centre button on this flow.

### 2.9 3-stage Centre case reveal and tutor-pays B2B fee flow `[was #582]`

**MUST** — progressive reveal for `Centre` cases. Phones, WhatsApp, and private chat stay gated under **#783** `[was #255]` until intro confirmation / admin fee paid rules are satisfied. Fee desk invoicing of the tutor reuses **#760** / **#785**; this ticket does not rebuild the payer invoice UI.

1. **Stage 1 — Lead / shortlist (pre-accept):** show centre *type*, rough district, subject/level, and rate range. Centre brand is **Verified Centre Partner** / **認證合作中心** (or a light public name **only** if the centre has explicitly opted in). Full centre name, address, phone, WhatsApp, and private chat are hidden in the UI **and** the network payload.
2. **Stage 2 — Tutor accepts:** mandatory Cap. 57 independent-service screen (independent self-employed operator, not centre staff; centre/parent pays tuition directly; tutor pays the applicable admin fee, including the same-centre ladder).
